'''Rivels''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He sold equipment modifications using planetary commendations as a [[Currency/Legends|currency]] at the [[Olaris Spaceport]], in the bombed [[City/Legends|city]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Behind the scenes==
Rivels appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Modification Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Taris.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Rivels was removed from the game along with the rest of the Modification Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
